text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, a kind of mathematical rule. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data usually leads to better models and more accurate predictions.
